description: An expander for Sequel 8 and Sequel 16: four slots that hold every knob and button on the sequencer and put them back on a button press or a trigger

params.text: Copies every knob and button setting of the sequencer into this slot, overwriting whatever was there
Puts this slot's stored settings back onto the sequencer

inputs.text: A trigger here saves into this slot, as the button beside it does
A trigger here loads this slot, as the button beside it does

notes: this module does nothing on its own: it has to stand immediately to the right of a Sequel 8 or a Sequel 16, and the lamp at the top right is lit when it is placed correctly
the four rows are the four slots, with the save button and its trigger jack on the left and the load button and its trigger jack on the right
loading a slot moves the sequencer's own knobs and buttons, so the change is visible on its panel
the maker gave none of these eight buttons or eight jacks a name, so an untagged one would show an empty tooltip
menu: Use DD cable color scheme - Light — replaces Rack's cable colour list with five colours of the maker's, after a confirmation step; the item ends in Dark under the Rack dark-panel setting
